statusDefinitions.ready: Dependencies are done and an agent may execute it.
statusDefinitions.blocked: Cannot proceed; statusReason explains the blocker.
statusDefinitions.awaiting_human: Requires a real person, device, physical print or store account.

milestones.title: Foundation
milestones.goal: A reproducible, agent-operable Flutter repository that builds on Android and iOS.

tasks.title: Implement final-PDF allowance and entitlement model
tasks.objective: Allow one complete final PDF generation for free and represent a lifetime entitlement independently of store APIs.
acceptance: Step 1 preview generation never consumes the free use.

Backing out before final generation or a failed final-PDF build does not consume it.
Sharing or printing an already-generated final PDF never consumes another use.
Lifetime entitlement bypasses the allowance.
State-transition tests cover reinstall/restore assumptions explicitly.

A failed ownership check with no existing purchase leaves the paywall ready rather than stuck busy.
Explicit Restore purchase remains available and reports when nothing is found.
Tests cover preflight restore, already-owned recovery, no-purchase recovery and non-stuck error state.

tasks.title: Restore lifetime ownership before showing free-use messaging
tasks.objective: Treat a reinstalled lifetime owner as unlocked before any first-free-PDF messaging is shown.
acceptance: On app startup, Photo Cut silently checks store ownership when the local lifetime flag is absent.
A restored lifetime purchase is persisted locally and the user sees a one-time localized confirmation instead of first-free-PDF messaging.
Subsequent launches with the local lifetime entitlement skip the store restore check and the restored-purchase confirmation.
Before showing the first-free-PDF confirmation, the review flow performs a fallback ownership check when local entitlement is still fresh.
A failed store ownership check is distinguishable from a confirmed no-purchase result and does not falsely claim the user has no purchase.
English, Spanish, French, Portuguese and German copy covers restored ownership and unavailable ownership checks.
Controller, app-startup and review widget tests cover reinstall restore, already-local ownership, no purchase and failed ownership checks.

tasks.title: Add protected Android Play release workflow
tasks.objective: Generate a signed Android App Bundle for internal Play testing through GitHub Actions without depending on a developer workstation or committed signing secrets.
acceptance: Android release signing reads protected environment variables or an ignored local key.properties when present while ordinary CI keeps its existing debug-signed release APK fallback.
A manual GitHub Actions workflow protected by the play-release environment reconstructs the upload keystore only on the runner, runs validation/analyze/tests and builds a release AAB.
The workflow verifies the upload certificate SHA-256 before the build and verifies the generated AAB is signed by that same certificate.
The generated artifact is named from the app version/build and is directly suitable for Play Console upload.
No keystore, password, key.properties or other signing secret is committed.
verification: GitHub Actions CI run 36883096302: Quality and Android — success
GitHub Actions CI run 36883096302: iOS simulator build — success
Protected workflow execution is delegated to M4-H02 so signing secrets remain a human-controlled gate.

tasks.title: Accept valid self-signed upload certificate warnings
tasks.objective: Keep AAB signature verification strict about cryptographic validity and certificate identity without failing on the expected self-signed upload certificate chain warning.
acceptance: The Play release workflow verifies the AAB JAR signature successfully without treating the upload certificate's self-signed chain warning as a build failure.
The workflow still extracts the generated AAB signer certificate and requires its SHA-256 fingerprint to match the known Photo Cut upload certificate.
A mismatched or invalid signature still fails the workflow.
No signing secret or certificate private material is committed.
